name: skillloom
description: Policy-gated self-learning for portable Agent Skills across Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Policy-gated self-learning for portable Agent Skills
interface.longDescription: Capture reusable task evidence, validate immutable candidates, and choose manual, policy, or Hermes-style learning with quarantine and rollback evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $setup-skillloom to host or connect the private Hub and Obsidian surface.
Use $capture-learning to preserve this reusable workflow safely.
Use $curate-skills to review a managed skill before changing it.
Use $autonomous-learning when Skillloom requests a post-task review.
